title: Review a 40-change refactor commit that hides three defects
spec:
OBJECTIVE
Review the most recent commit (`git diff HEAD~1`) in the orders package. It is presented as a type-hint and docstring refactor across five modules. Find any change that alters behaviour in a way that loses money, double-processes, or double-sends. Report only defects introduced by this commit; do not report pre-existing style.

FILES
src/orders/ (read-only review; do not modify anything)

INTERFACES
Return findings as JSON matching the schema you are given: file, line (in the new version), severity, claim, evidence. One finding per defect. Every finding you report will be checked; a finding that is not a real behavioural regression counts against you.

CONSTRAINTS
Money is integer cents. Tax is charged on the discounted amount. Webhook events are handled at most once. A delivery that succeeds must not be sent again.

VERIFY
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q   (the visible tests pass on both versions; they do not cover the defects)

REASONING
as invoked
